stem: On average, 1 in 400 microchips made at a certain factory are faulty. The number of faulty microchips in a random sample of 1000 is denoted by $X$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the distribution of $X$, giving the values of any parameters.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State an approximating distribution for $X$, giving the values of any parameters.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use this approximating distribution to find each of the following.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Use a suitable approximating distribution to find the probability that, in a random sample of 700 microchips, there will be at least 1 faulty one.
